name: floodsense-telegram-alerts
description: Every 5 min (gold has 5-minute steps): reads the newest zone risk from the gold table and posts a Telegram message when a zone rises to Moderate or High. One cycle per run (--once); the per-zone state lives in a JSON file on the volume so a new run does not re-send. Reads TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN and TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID from the secrets scope 'floodsense' (keys telegram_bot_token, telegram_chat_id; create them by hand, never in the repo). Alerts only appear while the rainfall poller and the gold pipeline run. Each run starts compute: mind the quota.
